messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — Acme's security team flagged CAIQ: Network controls. They want explicit language on PrivateLink vs public egress, and who is responsible for VPC flow logs / endpoint logging. This is blocking the SOW sign. Any short copy we can paste into the CAIQ?
mira: Can you paste the exact questions? acme asked: 'Who manages private endpoints and egress logging? Are logs forwarded to customer SIEM or Redwood?'
samir: TL;DR: Redwood manages the control plane and model hosts in our VPCs for hosted deployments; customer manages their VPC, endpoints, and routing when using Private/Dedicated. For Private (VPC peered) deployments we can optionally stream audit logs to customer Kinesis/Logstash.
eve: Suggested plain-language CAIQ answer (short):

```
Network / Egress: Redwood provides a managed inference control plane and, in hosted mode, egress to model artifacts and telemetry originates from Redwood-managed subnets. For Private/Dedicated deployments, customers provision VPC connectivity (VPC peering, PrivateLink, or dedicated network links) and are responsible for VPC endpoint lifecycle, routing rules, and local egress controls.

Logging: Redwood captures platform audit logs and can, by configuration, forward infrastructure audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3, Kinesis, or SIEM) when configured as part of a Private deployment or Dedicated VPC integration. For hosted customers who do not enable log forwarding, Redwood retains audit logs per the contract and provides access via support/console.

Shared responsibility summary:
- Redwood: control plane availability, model hosting, platform audit logs, key management integrations for platform keys.
- Customer: VPC networking, endpoint policies, local egress rules, and customer-managed KMS keys when BYOK is enabled.
```
mira: That looks good. Can we add one-liner about PrivateLink specifically?
samir: Add: "When using AWS PrivateLink, the customer owns the VPC endpoint and its policy; Redwood terminates inbound traffic on the PrivateLink interface on the customer's behalf and does not modify customer endpoint policies."
josh-sales: FYI on the POC/pricing side — adding log-forwarding to customer SIEM for the POC will add ~2 engineer-days and a $500/mo ingestion cost (depending on volume). Customer asked if Redwood can absorb the POC cost.
eve: For CAIQ answers, avoid pricing details — keep security posture language only. For the SOW we can list optional deliverable: log-forwarding integration (time & cost estimate).
sec-bot: Checklist link: https://redwood.internal/sales/caicq-templates/network-answers (permissions required) :white_check_mark:
alex: Can someone paste a single-paragraph answer we can drop into the CAIQ field? Customer wants it in the SIG template text box.
mira: One-paragraph pasteable: "Redwood operates a managed inference control plane. For hosted deployments, Redwood controls platform-hosted network egress and retains platform audit logs under the agreed retention. For Private/Dedicated deployments customers provision and own VPC endpoints (including AWS PrivateLink) and are responsible for endpoint policies, routing, and local egress controls. Redwood can forward platform audit logs and optional request metadata to customer-managed sinks (S3/Kinesis/SIEM) for Private/Dedicated integrations when configured; forwarding setup is an optional deliverable documented in the SOW."
samir: I shortened it further for the CAIQ box: "Redwood provides a managed control plane. Customers using Private/Dedicated deployments own VPC endpoints and local egress controls. Redwood can, by configuration, forward platform audit logs to customer-managed sinks (S3/Kinesis/SIEM); this is an optional integration included in the SOW."
josh-sales: Perfect. I'll paste that and push for the POC add-on in the SOW. Customer asked for a timeline — can we say 5 business days for log-forwarding POC?
eve: 5 business days is fair for basic forwarding to S3/Kinesis given access and IAM role setup. If customer wants field-level request data or SIEM parsing, add 3-5 more days.
alex: Thanks team. I'll paste samir's shortened paragraph into the CAIQ and follow up about the SOW with the cost/timeline. If Acme asks for code snippets for endpoint policy I'll ping samir. :thumbsup:
samir: If needed, sample VPC endpoint policy for PrivateLink: 
```json
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Principal": "*", "Action": "elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers", "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```
mira: Added to CRM: CAIQ updated + follow-up task to attach SOW addendum for log-forwarding.
alex: closing this thread for now — will reopen if Acme requests more detail. :rocket:
